insight: Recent rain (5.1 mm over the past few days) is washing urban runoff into the surf — the single biggest cause of beach contamination — especially near storm drains and creek mouths. The model's main signals right now: 5.1 mm of rain has fallen, washing bacteria-laden runoff into the surf; high tide timing is lowering risk — how long before mid-morning the last high tide fell, which sets how much the water has just washed off the upper beach; and limited sunlight is raising risk (less UV to disinfect the water). The most recent sample, 3 days ago, was excellent at 20 MPN/100mL.
